>
[Ocean Wariness](/Feats.aspx?ID=5279) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 19

</column>

---

Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about [alghollthu](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=358) mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your defenses against [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39), [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40), and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks.
